meta.boundarySource: Census cartographic boundary files via us-atlas@3.0.1 (states-10m, counties-10m)
meta.method: State and primary county = Census boundary polygon containing the ZCTA internal point; relationship file used when the point falls outside simplified polygons; nearest state as last resort. Other counties come from the relationship file.
meta.caveat: ZCTAs approximate USPS ZIP codes. PO-box-only and single-organization ZIPs may be missing.
